facts.fact: 作者称抽象表现主义（Abstract Expressionism）是由CIA的Tom Braden发明的。
facts.anchor: Abstract Expressionism was invented by a CIA guy called Tom Braden.

facts.fact: 战后Braden加入CIA，掌管一个叫International Organizations Division的部门。
facts.anchor: After the war Braden joined CIA, where he ran something called the International Organizations Division.

facts.fact: Braden通过IOD旗下的Congress for Cultural Freedom，在其轻信的主编、英国诗人Stephen Spender主持下帮助出版《Encounter》杂志。
facts.anchor: Braden helped publish Encounter magazine under the guidance of its gullible Editor-in-Chief, genius English poet Stephen Spender

facts.fact: Peggy Guggenheim的父亲Benjamin于1912年4月15日星期一随RMS Titanic沉没身亡，她因此继承钱财。
facts.anchor: her father, Benjamin, perished on RMS Titanic back on Monday, April 15th, 1912

facts.fact: Braden问Guggenheim哪位美国艺术家最可能帮上美国的忙，她毫不犹豫地回答“Jackson Pollock”。
facts.anchor: her reply, without hesitation, was “Jackson Pollock.”

facts.fact: 1946年1月14日星期一上午，Braden在纽约长岛East Hampton的Springs区830 Springs Fireplace Road一座改造谷仓的画室里与Pollock单独会面。
facts.anchor: on Monday morning, January 14th, 1946, during a one-on-one visit with Pollock at the latter’s atelier in a converted barn at 830 Springs Fireplace Road in the Springs area of East Hampton

facts.fact: 1951年初，成百上千幅原创抽象表现主义作品开始神秘出现在苏联的机场、火车站等地。
